firstPlayerRule: The first person to say aloud the opposite of “up” goes first.
houseFallback: If the official instruction leaves an unresolved tie or cannot be applied, agree to choose randomly. This is this site's suggested house rule.
clarifications: The basic game removes the six Flip cards; the selected variant tile is placed before play.
